vl100.title: Eastman: Samuel Eastman VL100
vl100.scope: Model 100 violin described as a staple of string programs and suitable for beginning and advancing players; manufacturer claim.

va100.title: Eastman: Samuel Eastman VA100
va100.scope: Model 100 viola with 11–16.5 inch size range for beginning and advancing players.

vc100.title: Eastman: Samuel Eastman VC100
vc100.scope: Model 100 cello 1/10–4/4; Eastman calls Model 100 a staple of string programs.

vb80.title: Eastman: Samuel Eastman VB80
vb80.scope: Model 80 bass explicitly described as ideal for schools, rentals and beginning players; fully laminated construction and Rubner brass tuning machines.

distinctions: VL100 already existed and is linked rather than redeclared.
Model 100 school-program framing is manufacturer evidence, not a universal school standard.
VB80 school/rental durability is a separate design goal from carved Model 100 instruments.
Rubner on VB80 refers to tuning machines, not instrument maker.
